commands.command:
sed -n '1,260p' build.py && printf '
--- docs/assets/time.js ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' docs/assets/time.js && printf '
--- files ---
' && rg --files content docs tests | sort

sed -n '1,520p' build.py; printf '
--- tests/test_s1.py ---
'; sed -n '1,520p' tests/test_s1.py; printf '
--- status/diff ---
'; git status --short; git diff -- build.py docs/assets/time.js tests/test_s1.py

TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),vm=require("vm"); let e={dateTime:"9999-12-31T23:59:59Z",textContent:"9999-12-31 23:59 UTC",title:"9999-12-31 23:59 UTC",getAttribute:()=>e.title}; document={querySelectorAll:()=>[e]}; vm.runInThisContext(fs.readFileSync("docs/assets/time.js","utf8")); if(e.textContent!=="9999-12-31 23:59 UTC"||e.title!=="9999-12-31 23:59 UTC") throw Error(e.textContent);'
